title: GuildMembers addon
body:
Adds an additional interface for the GuildForge plugin that displays the members of each guild, both online and offline. This is designed to allow each player to see who is in the same guild as them, regardless of their server status. Additionally, the plugin displays the number of points earned by each guild member for informational purposes.
Plugin installation: move the plugin file to your /plugins folder and restart the server. No configuration is required, and the plugin will automatically connect to GuildForge.
